# Release check: 2026-11-28, v1.2.1

A fresh agent with no context installed v1.2.1 from GitHub, followed only the README and linked docs, and chose the Vonage (Nexmo) Conversation API 2.0.1 from the [APIs.guru OpenAPI Directory](https://github.com/APIs-guru/openapi-directory/blob/main/APIs/nexmo.com/conversation/2.0.1/openapi.yaml): 23 operations, bearer JWT, a five-shape `oneOf`. It also ran 37 deliberate breaks against validation. The spec is now a test fixture.

What worked: install, `init` and CI as documented; all 23 operations generated; server URL, auth, parameter tables, minimum/maximum, enums and nested request fields correct; no invented error codes; the validator caught invented parameters, wrong Required flags, wrong query enum values, invented status codes, empty fields, wrong versions, wrong paths, invented response fields, missing required fields and lifecycle mismatches.

| Finding | Outcome in v1.2.2 |
| --- | --- |
| Freshly generated docs failed: request bodies defined under `components/requestBodies` were not followed, so three docs said "Not applicable" | Fixed |
| A failing baseline hid new errors | Fixed by the above: generated Vonage docs pass as generated |
| Missed: invented table rows (top-level and nested) | Fixed: every Request Body row must exist in the spec |
| Missed: wrong enum values inside JSON examples | Fixed: examples are checked at every depth |
| Missed: invented values in a table's allowed values | Fixed |
| Missed: invented fields inside a `oneOf` shape, in requests and responses | Fixed |
| Missed: a changed field type in the table | Fixed |
| Missed: auth changed to "none" or to an API key | Fixed |
| Missed: a different server URL | Fixed |
| Missed: `last_reviewed: "yesterday"` | Fixed |
| Missed: "Needs SME input" replaced with invented prose | Not fixable by a format check; stated in the README |
| Date examples changed with the machine's time zone | Fixed: specs are read without converting dates |
| "Deprecated as of 2.0.1" invented from the spec version | Fixed: says the version is not in the spec |
| Nested `oneOf` shapes not documented | Fixed: each shape's fields are listed with their option number |
| PASS with "Compared 0 endpoint docs" | Fixed: reports SKIP |
| An unedited template passed | Fixed: leftover template instructions and template descriptions are errors |
| Owner "y" accepted though not in the owners registry | Changed: now a warning |
| Skips do not fail the run | Changed: new `--strict` option |
| `help` did not list `--owner`; success status and parameter defaults not shown | Fixed |

Found while fixing: the spec's own examples show fields its schemas do not define (for example `end_time` in legs). The generator now leaves those out of examples and says which fields it left out.
